concepts.core_mechanic: You don't push the car directly — you slide the Sun across the sky and its light is a physical downward wind. Parking the Sun over the car's rear spoiler tips and rolls it; parking it over a tree's canopy makes that side sag like a seesaw. A tap of eclipse cuts the light instantly, letting momentum carry the car cleanly off a ramp edge.
concepts.juice: Gatito the cat's little hands do big, wobbly grabs at the apples as they pass
concepts.lose: Perder: si el coche cae en un foso o se acaba el tiempo.
concepts.palette: Paper-white background, the five crayon drawings untouched and huge, thin black doodle ground line, one accent: warm yellow light-cone from the Sun.
concepts.pitch: Mueves el sol por el cielo y su luz empuja físicamente el cochecito donde viaja el gato. Usa el haz para rodar cuesta arriba, bascular árboles-balancín y saltar un foso hasta aparcar justo en la puerta de casa antes del anochecer.

roles.role: The wide-eyed passenger-driver riding visibly on top of the car; squash-and-stretch face reacts to speed, bumps and near-falls.
The star you control: a big crayon sun sliding along the top of the screen, pouring a visible cone of light that acts as wind/weight.
Two trees act as flexible seesaw ramps: light on the canopy bends them down, darkness lets them spring back and fling the car.
The finish: one big house on a hill at the right edge, door open; park the car inside its doorway box to win.
The physics hero: a chunky AABB car body on two wheel circles, rolling, tipping and launching with the cat aboard.

concepts.title: El Sol Empuja al Gato
concepts.win: Ganar: aparcar el coche con el gato dentro de la puerta de la casa.

concepts.controls: Flechas / WASD: acelerar y cambiar de carril. Espacio: freno.
concepts.core_mechanic: Speed and time are the same resource: sunshine boosts your speed but burns the sunset clock three times faster, while tree shade slows the car yet almost freezes the Sun. Winning means constantly diving in and out of moving tree-shadows — a sunny straight tempts you, a shady slalom saves you.
concepts.juice: Wheel-spin crayon smears, dust puffs when braking, speed lines in sunlight, the Sun squashes bigger and redder as it sinks, screen shake on tree bumps, big floating '+SOL' / '¡SOMBRA!' combo text at each house gate.
concepts.lose: Perder: si el sol se pone por completo antes de llegar a la casa final.
concepts.palette: Paper-white sky that warms to crayon orange near the horizon as the Sun sinks; the five drawings stay original colours, shade shown as soft green translucent blobs under each tree.
concepts.pitch: El gato conduce a casa contra el atardecer: pisar el acelerador bajo el sol corre mucho pero quema el reloj, mientras que esconderse en la sombra de los árboles casi detiene la puesta de sol. Serpentea entre sol y sombra, cruza casas-puerta que dan segundos y llega a la gran casa final antes de que anochezca.

roles.role: The driver, drawn big leaning out of the car, ears flapping; he ducks happily in shade and squints in glare.
The living timer: a huge sun sinking steadily at the top-centre; its height is the clock and its light tints the whole screen.
Rows of trees cast moving oval shadows on the road; shade zones are the safe-but-slow mechanic and trunk AABBs are the obstacles.
Small checkpoint houses line the route as gates that add seconds; one giant final house is the finish line.
Your racer, side-view scrolling right, lane-switching between three road bands with real acceleration and braking.

concepts.title: Carrera contra el Atardecer
concepts.win: Ganar: cruzar la puerta de la casa grande final antes de que el sol toque el horizonte.

concepts.controls: Flechas ◀ ▶ / A D: mover el carrito. Espacio: soltar al gato al inicio.
concepts.core_mechanic: The cat-ball only breaks the house when it's sun-charged: route it up through the Sun's rays to set it glowing, then that one glowing hit smashes a chunk of wall, while a cold cat just bounces off with a sad 'miau'. You must deliberately bounce AWAY from the house to recharge.
concepts.juice: Squash-and-stretch cat on every bounce with a tiny drawn '¡miau!' pop, golden particle trail while charged, crayon-chip burst and screen shake on each smash, car headlights flashing on saves, combo text '¡x3 AL SOL!' for charge-break chains, title screen: cat asleep on the car under the big Sun, 'Pulsa ENTER'.
concepts.lose: Perder: si el gato cae tres veces por debajo del coche.
concepts.palette: Paper-white playfield, black doodle border, warm gold glow only around a charged cat; all five drawings stay big, bright and unrecoloured.
concepts.pitch: Un frontón felino en una sola pantalla: el coche es tu paleta, el gato es la pelota, y la casa de arriba es el muro que hay que abrir. Pero el gato solo rompe la pared cuando viene calentito del sol, así que cada golpe bueno empieza rebotando lejos de la casa, cargándote de luz.

roles.role: The ball: the round smiling cat face, bouncing with squash-and-stretch, meowing and turning golden when charged.
A huge sun fixed top-centre whose swinging rays are the recharge zone; flying through the light charges the cat for one smash.
Two trees mid-screen are springy bumpers whose canopies grow a step bushier after each hit, nudging the ball's angles and shrinking the gaps over the minute.
The big house at the top is the breakable wall: roof and walls chip away in chunks, exposing the glowing open door behind them.
The paddle: the blue car zooming along the bottom, headlights as the hitting edge; its tilt adds English to the bounce.

concepts.title: Frontón Felino: ¡Calienta al Gato!
concepts.win: Ganar: romper con el gato cargado suficientes trozos de la casa para abrir la puerta entera.
